name: Obadiah
role: Ahab's steward, who hid the prophets
whenBasis: In the reigns of Ahab (≈874–853 BC in Thiele's reckoning) and his sons; the reckonings in the Reign tab differ by a few years.
summary: The official over Ahab's palace, who feared the LORD greatly. When Jezebel was killing the LORD's prophets, he hid a hundred of them in two caves, fifty in each, and fed them bread and water. Searching the land for grass in the drought, he met Elijah, and was afraid to tell Ahab, lest the Spirit carry Elijah away and Ahab kill him.
body: Elijah promises him he will show himself to Ahab that day, and Obadiah goes and arranges the meeting. He is not the prophet whose book bears the same name.
